items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I talked to Jimmy Rushing about that one day. We got to laughing about it.

ctx.x: Yeah. I often told talking about the late, great Jimmy Rushing (?) about him and a the situation that has developed in, I think, it was '26 .../The Kansas City Monarch's were playing the St. Louis Stars, a baseball game. In those days, they'd have a baseball game and a dance. Benny Moten (?) was the big band in Kansas City.
